family: For every integer n>=0, f_n(x) is the XOR of all n input bits, with f_0(empty)=0. L is the language of odd-parity binary strings. The verifier accepts exactly an empty witness and an odd-parity input.
theorem: For this one fixed total uniform polynomial-time family, C_B2(f_n)=n-1 for every integer n>=1, in the full B2 model of rules.md. Consequently liminf over all integer lengths n of C_B2(f_n)/n=1, giving the joint coefficient/exponent (1,1).
